title: O'Deadly Skyrim
tagline: O'Deadly Skyrim's decision template, plus 1.1's beast-blood context and actions: turned NPCs can change into their beast form and back, and the blood gift.
description:
Used by O'Deadly Skyrim (A SkyrimNet environmental mod). Decision template: when the mod is about to involve a real NPC, it asks SkyrimNet's decision model whether that character, given their bio and the situation, would do it (or, for the beast-form claim, whether a companion is willing). Without a decisions provider the mod falls back to its own character filter.

1.1 (Blood Born Pathogen): a character bio section tells NPCs who caught or were given beast blood what they are, who gave it to them, and whether they are in beast form right now. Actions: TransformToBeast and TransformBack (NPCs the mod turned: werewolf, vampire lord, werebear; they stay changed until they change back, or until the fight they changed for is over), AcceptBloodGift and GiveBloodGift. Needs PapyrusUtil (already required by the mod). 1.1.5: BecomeVampireLord for followers who already are vampires (MCM toggle, off by default). 1.1.8: when OStim Beast Form is installed, Serana and the living Companions Circle leaders already have transform data (TransformToBeast / TransformBack).
author: That Guy (Coronerra)
